subject.title: improve(imessage): manage imsg setup and plugin skill ownership

question: Should the `imsg` skill move from always-bundled `skills/imsg` to plugin-scoped `extensions/imessage/skills` even though plugin skills publish only when the iMessage plugin is activated?
rationale: The plugin-owned shape matches newer channel-plugin patterns, but it intentionally changes skill availability and stale-session repair behavior for existing users, which needs maintainer ownership rather than an automated cleanup verdict.

options.title: Accept plugin-scoped imsg skill after fixes
options.body: Keep the ownership move, require the docs contradiction and macOS setup proof to be fixed, and treat inactive-plugin skill loss as intended product behavior.

options.title: Preserve always-available imsg skill
options.body: Keep or reintroduce an always-bundled compatibility skill until OpenClaw has an explicit migration or always-on channel-skill contract.

options.title: Split setup from skill relocation
options.body: Land the Homebrew setup help separately and pause the skill visibility change for a narrower owner decision.

recommendation.title: Accept plugin-scoped imsg skill after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the ownership move, require the docs contradiction and macOS setup proof to be fixed, and treat inactive-plugin skill loss as intended product behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md lists Tyler Yust for iMessage and history ties him to prior `imsg` skill/docs ownership, making him the best available owner for the skill visibility choice.
